notes:
### Added

- **Media Manager grouping:** grid and list views group items by day (Today / Yesterday / date) or by conversation, with a "No grouping" option; group order follows the current sort.

### Fixed

- **Opening Media Manager details no longer reflows the results:** the details panel is now an overlay drawer at every width, so the grid/list underneath never shifts or scrolls when a file is selected.
- **Thumbnails show the full image** (`contain` instead of `cover`) so screenshots and tall images aren't cropped, with a smaller file-type placeholder icon.
- **Terminal copy/paste chords (Ctrl+Shift+C, Ctrl+V / Ctrl+Shift+V) work again** — a return-value inversion at the xterm boundary made xterm swallow the handled keys; the initial terminal fit is also cancelled cleanly on unmount.
- **Switching or creating a chat session now returns you to the chat column** — the Media Manager closes automatically on any chat-navigation action.
